purpose: Part 1 — compliance audit of the Reliability & Data-Coverage Audit requirements. Classified by inspecting the artifacts themselves, not by reading the reports.
keyFinding: The reliability dataset was written at commit d773b61, BEFORE Phase 5 (8f7ae2a). It therefore predates every Phase 5 field (informal signature, programme scale) and every Phase 5 population (45 proxy positives, 30 inversion-surfaced vendors). It is stale rather than wrong.

requirements.stillValid: partially — the 77 rows are valid for the pre-Phase-5 fields
requirements.invalidatedBy: Phase 5 added 45 researched proxy positives and 30 researched inversion vendors with no account record; and added two fields the schema has no column for

requirements.gap: BLOCKED and NOT_ATTEMPTED are collapsed into one column, which is the exact distinction the mandate makes mandatory. No denominator column, no primary_failure_mode column. Missing programme scale, informal signature, temporal.

requirements.result: printed in the report, not persisted
requirements.gap: language used the DISCOVERY QUERY language as a proxy for company language; Canada was not separated from USA; no persisted file

requirements.requirement: Bounded CRM forensic test across non-partner roles
requirements.gap: publicly indexed vacancies, job boards/mirrors and LinkedIn job surfaces were never systematically attempted as source families — only 4 ad-hoc searches on 4 accounts

requirements.requirement: CRM funnel + unique incremental conclusions per source
requirements.gap: no unique-incremental attribution per job family or per source family in the file; the funnel exists only in report prose
JS-only careers, indexed-despite-unsupported-ATS, historical-despite-no-board and blocked were not separated; not persisted as a file
covers query families only; Phase 5 reseller inversion and proxy-positive harvest are not in a funnel
D1, D3, R2, R4, R5, E2, E3, C1-C5, P2, P3 are never assigned. No examples column. Fixability lacks LICENSED_DATA_MAY_HELP and HUMAN_RESEARCH_MAY_HELP.

requirements.invalidatedBy: Phase 5 F1 corrected the headline to 66.2% and introduced BLOCKED, which this file does not carry

requirements.gap: not persisted as a dataset; known Introw customers were not included as false-negative subjects
not persisted; several required categories never checked
counterparty websites, partner directories and partner portals are absent as families; several rows were hand-entered; no research-cost column
counterparty inversion, non-partner jobs and directories are not separate increments; no explicit double-count control
no fixability column; not persisted; predates Phase 5 fields
predates programme scale and informal signature; no n column; no harm-to-qualification judgement

requirements.requirement: Top 10 failures by frequency and by commercial impact
requirements.gap: frequency list has only 6 measured classes because the taxonomy was never fully assigned
no commercial workflows column, no programme scale column, no CONFLICTING/BLOCKED states used

requirements.requirement: Radar vs deep manual research, sample frozen BEFORE research
requirements.gap: the sample was chosen AFTER the Radar output was known and was not frozen as an artifact. The mandate makes freezing-before mandatory. Must be redone with a properly frozen sample.
partner_people_state reads not_attempted on all 77 rows. An earlier phase measured 2/18 and the capability was dropped; this mandate requires it measured, not assumed.

requirements.stillValid: yes as far as it goes
requirements.gap: LinkedIn was never attempted as a distinct source family; accessible-vs-blocked was never measured

requirements.requirement: Programme scale kept distinct from directory entries
requirements.gap: directory_entries_observed and unique_partner_entities_observed are not separated from explicit_company_claimed_scale in any dataset
no measurement of UNIQUE commercial information the field contributes, which is what the decision is supposed to rest on
missing compliance audit, population/denominators, entity resolution, programme scale, informal signature, language coverage, production reliability, next engineering priorities as named sections
